note: tester.38 release manifest, started from the tester.37 manifest: the kmd and control rows move to the main commit with BD-292, BD-293, BD-295, BD-297 and the stage 2 queue reset of node 2; every other row keeps its tester.37 commit. BD-315: the system, wow64, desktop, zink and gl rows move to the t38/bd315-uqueue-* heads (global locks deleted at unload; the system head also has the util tests Windows build fix), and recipe_commit to the main commit with BD-317 (the RADV host tests link the real monitored fence). BD-211: the zink and gl rows move to merges of their BD-315 heads with the memstream temporary-file fix.

outputs.pair_skew: The x86 row b11faa28 and the x64 row 9e14530f are the lines a45cf31d and 3b660ba0 with two merges each: BD-290, the tail of a compute buffer copy whose last thread would load past the source range copied with CP DMA (1f56cdaa, ba1df9df), and BD-200(a), a VK_SYNC_WAIT_PENDING wait that returns at submission and not at completion (df436d78, c7456a94). The pair before that: The x86 row a45cf31d and the x64 row 3b660ba0 are 8b4215c3 and fce8f953 with the BD-200 timeline wait change (27ea1698, 615121c0) reverted: in ASSISTED mode the monitored fence waited for GPU completion in place of submission, and Quake II RTX lost 11 % of its frame rate. The x86 system Vulkan row 8b4215c3 is the tester.35 wow64 line 17de7ab1 with the BD-200 timeline wait fix (27ea1698), the BD-203 external buffer report (a840b31a), the BD-287 upload pad (a5877980), the BD-179 stopped-adapter fence wait (a52627c7) and its WoW64 host test (8b4215c3). The x64 system row fce8f953 is the tester.35 system line 5dea8835 with the same BD-200, BD-203, BD-287 and BD-179 changes (615121c0, 6db68699, 0a4e8070, fce8f953). Only the x64 row has the BD-202 live BO budget (c52af544), the BD-206 GDI present worker (8ef83ef7 to 407d95b6) and the unified APU heap of BD-028 (f21279b9, c7474d7b, b064e507). The x86 line has no unified-heap commit. The tester.35 pair before that: The x86 system Vulkan row 17de7ab1 is the tester.34 wow64 line 9d8168c9 with the single-file disk cache on Windows (BD-216, 17de7ab1), and the x64 system row 5dea8835 is the tester.34 system line de66c413 with the same change. The tester.34 x86 line 9d8168c9 is the tester.33 wow64 line 20d7c8c9 with the BD-254 preamble and gather-slot fixes (cbe8dc03, f9191318, 771c666b), the BD-201 BO lifetime host test (d58067a4 to e7fb7053) and the fixes it shares with the x64 system line de66c413 (tester.33 line ad130cc2 with the same BD-201 test, 85486b52 to 874d30b2): the async compute threadgroup workaround on GFX1013 (x86 c0c1f240, x64 1f3f6938), the gfx1013 lowering of signed packed 4x8 dot products ported from dmorazasanchez/bc250-fsr4 v3 (x86 0f49b0ee to 8c452da1, x64 7ffc66ef to 67d3864e), driconf regular expressions on Windows, the process name at any path length, machine-profile driconf files, the per-application graphics settings, no GDS access without a GDS partition (BD-119), debugging variables read only in the lab flavour and the zstd 1.5.7 wrap. Only the x86 row reads MemoryOverflow and the WSI route switch in the 64-bit registry view (the x64 row reads that view natively). Only the x64 row has the compute-node border colour fix (3a5e0436) and the BD-212 fix that keeps the progress fence of a queue that goes with unretired work (fa4fadf7); the x64 row gets the instruction-prefetch padding (e92476c8) that the x86 line has had since before tester.33 (b3e45baf). The x86 settings reader uses the GDI-only WSI: MaxFrameLatency applies only to other GPUs on the DXGI path, and VSync 0 only skips the DWM wait. The x86 build does not port the x64 DXGI present or compute work.

rows.role: The system Vulkan ICD (radv-system): the tester.38 system line 9e14530f with BD-315: the global u_queue exit_mutex and the vk_wddm2 pending lock and condition are deleted when the ICD unloads (c6c3c0c1, the port of e4ec7ede) and the u_queue flag is set under the lock (d43c47d5, 72100150), and the Windows build fix of the util tests cache_test and u_queue_test (cd3b0dda, the pick of e7348711c92). That pick changes only src/util/tests: vulkan_radeon.dll of cd3b0dda differs from the d43c47d5 build only in the embedded git version string, the PE and debug directory stamps and the PDB GUID (28 bytes, same recipe and build directory), so the kit-bd315-av3 result of d43c47d5 (2026-11-05, 22631: the ICD unloads with no Application Verifier stop) holds for it.
